Candidate-by-candidate biographical research

Acquisition is unfinished. Downloading a page, a missing database row or an existing analytical disposition is not a completed research pass. Factual evidence, precision, timing and model eligibility are separate.

The fifteen scientific traits are retained, but this pass researches ten background traits. New claims are not promoted into frozen scientific models. A known narrow fact does not resolve every biographical detail. Dated age and birth-year evidence can remain partial; institutional affiliation is not inferred religious identity. Partial and detail-conflict flags can coexist with a qualified narrow fact. Unsearched people remain unsearched.

Search provenance distinguishes executed search strings, underlying-page follow-ups and reconstructed historical descriptions. Reconstructed descriptions do not establish that a source family was searched and cannot complete a pass. Retained-original re-extraction is identified separately from current page review; neither implies that the original source was newly acquired.

1,284 candidates; 746 documents reviewed; 301 previously unknown fields with new evidence, of which 174 now have a qualified value. Research passes: 12 completed; 200 in progress; 1,072 not yet researched. A completed research pass can still leave unknown facts.
